tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind the timeline header and day-group bands. Text on it: ink and ink-2 only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, calendar and matrix cells, navbar. ink, ink-2 and ink-3 all read on it.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and footers (column header, key bar, matrix header), input fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icon colour on surface, surface-tint and ground. 17:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and ground: detail lines, tab labels at rest. 8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on surface only (captions, weekday labels, hints). 4.9:1 on surface; do not use on ground or tinted fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on surface.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of ghost buttons, chips, inputs. Hover goes to #b4c0ba.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand primary: fills of the primary button, today marker, tab underline, nav indicator. Never as text on white (1.9:1).

tokens.name: mint-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the primary-button gradient.

tokens.name: mint-deep
tokens.usage: Mint when it is text or an icon, and the keyboard focus ring: 5.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: mint-bg
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill and soft mint surfaces, with mint-deep text.

tokens.name: mint-line
tokens.usage: Border of selected chips and mint surfaces.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text on mint fills: the primary button label. 9:1 on mint.

tokens.name: meal-column
tokens.usage: 6% mint wash behind the Breakfast, Dinner and Supper columns on the timeline.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Symptom text and icon on its pastel chip; destructive text.

tokens.name: food-cooked
